resources.string: Lets Scroll Voice Control swipe the screen up, down, or back when you say a voice command.

Voice: say "down", "up", "back".
Clap: 1 clap = down, 2 = up, 3 = back.
Motion: tilt phone forward = down, back = up.
Camera: swipe hand up past the front camera = down, swipe down = up.

Status dot (top-right, over other apps): mode color = watching, green flash = command recognized, red = this mode failed to start.
